components.name: Full-Batch Gradient Descent
components.description: Training uses batch gradient descent with the full dataset per iteration (no mini-batches), leveraging sparse matrix operations for memory efficiency.
components.quote: In this work, we perform batch gradient descent using the full dataset for every training iteration, which is a viable option as long as datasets fit in memory.

components.name: Dropout Regularization
components.description: Dropout is applied to all layers during training to introduce stochasticity and reduce overfitting.
components.quote: Stochasticity in the training process is introduced via dropout (Srivastava et al., 2014).

components.name: Precomputed Normalized Adjacency
components.description: The normalized adjacency matrix  is computed once in a preprocessing step before training, not recomputed each layer.
components.quote: We first calculate ˆA = ˜D− 12 ˜A ˜D− 12 in a pre-processing step.

components.name: Renormalisierte Adjazenz
components.description: The propagation matrix is D~^-1/2 A~ D~^-1/2 with A~ = A + I (renormalization trick).

components.name: Selbstschleifen
components.description: Self-loops are added to the adjacency matrix: A~ = A + I.

components.name: Propagationsregel
components.description: Each layer multiplies the normalised adjacency with the layer input before the weight matrix: H' = sigma(A_hat H W).
components.quote: layer-wise propagation rule:   H(l+1) = σ  ( ˜D− 12 ˜A ˜D− 12 H(l)W (l)  )  . (2) Here, ˜A = A + IN is the adjacency mat

components.name: Zwei Graph-Faltungsschichten
components.description: The model has two graph convolution layers (the adjacency is applied in both).
components.quote: we consider a two-layer GCN for semi-supervised node classification
